title: Storage and Cancellation Charges on Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services Engagements
content:
# Storage and Cancellation Charges

**Storage.** A finished engagement under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services left uncollected past the service's holding period carries the service's storage charge for each started month. The holding period and the storage charge per started month are fixed per service.

**Cancellation.** Where the engagement is cancelled after the service's cancellation window the service's cancellation charge stands, and the piece is returned whether or not the charge has been paid. Cancellation is the customer's stopping of the engagement before the report is issued, from requested, item received or in examination. The cancellation window and the cancellation charge are fixed per service.

**Separate lines.** The cancellation charge and the storage charge are each booked to the engagement as their own priced line under their own fee code, so the two never collapse into one figure.

## Storage on hypothetical figures

Under a service whose holding period is a hypothetical 30 calendar days and whose storage charge is a hypothetical 20 per started month:

| Days the finished engagement has gone uncollected | Storage charged |
|---|---|
| 30 | none, the holding period has not been passed |
| 31 | one started month, 20 |
| any day within the first started month after the holding period | 20 |
| the first day of the second started month after the holding period | two started months, 40 |

A started month is charged in full; the charge does not shrink for a month only partly used.

## Cancellation on hypothetical figures

Under a service whose cancellation window is a hypothetical 3 calendar days and whose cancellation charge is a hypothetical 45:

- Cancelled on the third calendar day after the engagement was taken: within the window, no cancellation charge.
- Cancelled on the fourth calendar day after the engagement was taken: after the window, the cancellation charge of 45 stands, and the piece is returned to the customer whether or not that 45 has been paid.

## Point answered

**An engagement was cancelled after the window and then left uncollected past the holding period. Is there one charge or two?** Two, each on its own priced line under its own fee code: the cancellation charge and the storage charge never collapse into one figure.
